source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: When choosing this unit to [Advance](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move) in your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), you may pay 1 **Pain token** to make it [Empowered](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain). For each [Advance](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move) while [Empowered](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain), skip the [Advance](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move) roll and give its models +8″ **Move** through that phase’s end.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
